name: @peartube/desktop-native
description: Native macOS shell scaffold for PearTube

scripts.generate: npm run ensure:host-sidecar && npm run ensure:host-sidecar-frameworks && npm run ensure:bare-runtime && xcodegen generate
scripts.build: npm run generate && xcodebuild -project PearTubeDesktop.xcodeproj -scheme PearTubeDesktop -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.test: npm run generate && npm run test:bridge && xcodebuild -project PearTubeDesktop.xcodeproj -scheme PearTubeDesktop -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO test
